build_unsupervised_baseline: build an UnsupervisedBaseline model using a sparse distributional space file and a similarity measure function
create_slqs_model: create an SLQS model from a sparse distributional space file with a configurable topk entropy parameter
compute_clarkeDE_similarity: compute the clarkeDE distributional inclusion score between two dense numpy vectors
compute_cosine_similarity: compute the cosine similarity between two dense numpy vectors using the cosine function
run_slqs_cos_predict: run the SLQS_Cos model to predict hypernymy scores combining entropy measures with cosine similarity
